_evidence: 0x0052dba4 runs 0x53e612 with esi = 0x84bc2a (static list head) and eax = 4: 'cmp dword [esi],0; jne' then 'mov esi,[esi]; shr eax,1; jae; or byte [esi+0x1f],0x40', i.e. the third node after the head gets bit 0x40 when the list is long enough. Image list: 0x84bc2a -> 0x84bc60 -> 0x84bc86 -> 0x84bcac -> null. The flag bytes +0x1f of the three nodes (0x84bc7f, 0x84bca5, 0x84bccb) are varied, and the links of the head and the first two nodes are drawn from their image successor, a later node of the same list or null (+0 next is nullable for 0x53e612), so the walk length (1..4 nodes) and which node is flagged vary. Every choice is an acyclic sublist of the image list: the walk always ends on a null link.
